notes.title: Patch 030

Map will be updated to account for this.[/p][/*][*][p] Items now have specific Icons for Food, Drink, Healing, Supplies[/p][/*][*][p] Abacus Sliders match new Item Icons for easier identification[/p][/*][*][p] Abacus Sliders save position[/p][/*][*][p] Changing prices with Abacus results in visual display of New Item Prices[/p][/*][*][p] Villagers can buy your For Sale items while you are gone[/p][/*][*][p] Updated Stamina Icon and Visual Representation[/p][/*][*][p] NPC UI Text no longer blurry[/p][/*][*][p] NPC UI Text changed to not scale (creates effect of conversation further away you must get close to read)[/p][/*][*][p] Testing NPC’s being “live” in all towns[/p][/*][*][p] Updated NPC navigation logic[/p][/*][*][p] Added Option to keep Player Name, Money, Status when starting new game[/p][/*][*][p] Controller navigation to autosave slider in menu[/p][/*][*][p] Removed Giant Transition Walls into Yorlen Harbor and Yorlen Village[/p][/*][*][p] Adjust some sound performance for Player Footsteps[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p] Floating NPC’s along ground headed to bed position at night[/p][/*][*][p] Not loading saved position on start[/p][/*][*][p] Putting on Shop Wheels for carts[/p][/*][*][p] NPC Torches not loading when traveling between towns[/p][/*][*][p] NPCs not waking up at dawn[/p][/*][*][p] Shop Items being damaged by weather[/p][/*][*][p] Added checks to NPC’s buying to not buy your purchased items [/p][/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214938/641b92bb55f92dedc643d67a03999b4afdc217bb.png[/img]

[h2]Hand holding? No.

After watching several streams, gathering positive & negative feedback, and plenty of discussions in the Discord....the issue I will be diving into this week and maybe next is the [b]Game Start[/b] and [b]increasing the information the player can organically find within the game world[/b].

This includes:
[list]
[*] No longer starting within the Prison, though you can still be sent there
[*] More direct feedback from NPC's during the trade/transaction process
[*] More upfront cause and effect with setting your prices
[*] Trying to squeeze in more targeted Dialogue.
[/list]
[b]Improved balancing [/b]will also be implemented to further show the progression that is needed for increasing your Merchant Status.

My goal is to have an [b]Update ready by Friday/Saturday[/b] for those that play [b]Beta Branch[/b] [u](You can too! No passcode required) [/u]to be able to jump in and start playing as I take quick notes on improvements.

[h3]A-Ha! Moments[/h3]

I have enjoyed watching so many have those "A-ha!" moments when playing as that is the absolute desire for this game, but it is [b]easy to see that players need more information to lead them to these moments[/b] and ensure the journey through the process has better balance and less frustration.

When this update hits it will require a New Game so please take note of that.



Thank you!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214938/887194300d3b4cf2b0637840b10b5abf51b56fc5.png[/img]

[h1]What's the Plan:[/h1]

For the next few weeks I’ll be working hard to continue adding to the main game.  Sound interactions were Majorly reworked, and items have been reworked as well in effort to allow for as many items to be interacted with as possible.

I am also trying to add in more dynamic environments and life.

[b]Overall I am focusing on 4 areas of the game map for the Initial EA Release. Prison Quarry, Ivernox, Yorlen Village, and Halcyon Harbor. [/b]

And much like the DEMO, after several people get their hands on it I will be bug fixing like mad to get it as solid/stable as possible [u][b]before starting to add more again[/b][/u].


[h2]Performance Matters:[/h2]

There was a progress delay…if you can call it that…that I self-implemented once I found a way to unlock close to 10-15 FPS for the avg computer. While this may be small for high end comps my goal was to make this as accessible as possible…but it is forcing tedious work redoing literally almost the entire map….it was a hard decision.

All Initial testing is done on a:
12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900 3.20 GHz, 80GB Ram
NVIDIA RTX4070
3440x1440 Monitor

I typically see 95+ FPS on Main Game Currently with High/Ultra Settings.


I tested creating more detailed environments (kind of getting away from the low poly look), but the cost was too great as I wanted better than “avg” performance for a open-world-ish Indie game.


I am pushing to be able to rework the Demo some prior to Steam Next Fest. As such I won’t be spending much time Fixing Minor bugs as they may not even be applicable once I bring over more Main Game scripts. [b]However Major or GameBreaking Bugs will be fixed promptly.[/b]

Thank you all for being such a great community and I look forward to continuing progress.

I’ll obviously be on the Discord like always but just wanted to give an update.

[h1]Villager AI Evolution[/h1]

- Villagers now have basic needs like Drinking, Eating, and Sleeping, adding more life and realism to their daily routines. You'll see them move purposefully through town, visiting local spots and interacting more naturally with their environment. Shortly to come they should also have a new goal: traveling between cities and villages, creating more dynamic movement across the game world.

[h1]Animations[/h1]

- While just placeholders for now...I've introduced them to ensure the logic behind animations is functioning correctly. This groundwork will make it easy to swap in more polished animations later, while giving villagers some life-like actions for now. Though watching them float around was kind of funny.

- Save System Improvements: Performance optimizations have been made to the save system, providing a smoother and faster save/load experience.

[h1]Great Results for Stress Test[/h1]

- I was very happy that the AI coding for the NPC's ran pretty well. While their current tasks are still simple I was able to maintain 95+ FPS even with nearly 200 active NPC's running around a singular village. (For reference there will ever only be a few dozen active at one time as the ones you don't see are placed into a dormant state or not rendered).

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed a large FPS drop that occurred when several villagers tried to buy items from the player. The system is now optimized to keep gameplay smooth during busy moments.

- Addressed a critical issue with item and player position consistency during loading. Items and characters will now appear exactly where they were saved, ensuring continuity without frustrating misplacements. This was little tricky due to everything being "physics" based but it's now working properly. These updates are just a glimpse of the exciting progress as I continue to bring more life and detail to your medieval world. Thank you for being part of this journey!

Previously, if the player committed a crime, such as stealing, it would only affect the player's relationship with the faction of that Shopkeeper. This week, I've made improvements to that system.

[h3]New "Charges" Stat[/h3]
The Player now has a [b]"Charges"[/b] stat, which acts as a bounty. This stat increases every time the Player commits a crime. In addition to this, committing crimes still negatively affects the Player's relationship with the applicable Faction. But don’t worry—the Player can pay off their Charges.

[h3]King's Road Tolls[/h3]
I've also introduced a basic [b]Toll[/b] for traveling the King's Road. Pay the toll to save time on your journey, or take the back roads to avoid it. But be warned:
[b]Entering the King's Road without payment[/b] will result in your crime being reported, your Charges increasing, and your standing with the Royal Family being negatively affected.

This system will continue to evolve and improve over time.
